content:
Super Micro Computer said it has started shipping NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 rack systems using direct liquid cooling. The announcement describes a new offering for customers building large artificial intelligence data centers.

Each rack combines 72 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs with 36 Vera CPUs. Super Micro provides the surrounding cooling, networking, storage, power and deployment services through its Data Center Building Block Solutions.

The company says its infrastructure can scale from five-megawatt sites to gigawatt-scale deployments. A 16-rack Vera Rubin NVL72 Scalable Unit contains 1,152 Rubin GPUs and 331 terabytes of HBM4 memory.

The shipments extend Super Micro's role as an infrastructure provider for NVIDIA's next-generation AI computing systems.
headline: Supermicro starts delivering liquid-cooled NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 rack systems
summary: Super Micro Computer has initiated shipments of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 liquid-cooled racks containing 72 Rubin GPUs.
